Distribution

Distribution services

We distribute your advertising locally, straight to your customers.

Get a quote 514-424-7936

The service in detail

For a store opening, a neighbourhood promotion or a new service launch, nothing beats a message placed directly in the hands of the people you want to reach. Groupe Gama distributes your flyers, leaflets, cards and samples in the areas you choose — neighbourhood by neighbourhood, street by street — and confirms the distribution.

What’s included

  • Residential door-to-door by neighbourhood or postal code
  • Distribution in stores, offices and buildings
  • Samples and small promotional items
  • Distribution report with areas covered and dates
  • Greater Montreal, Laval, North Shore and South Shore

How it works

  1. Choose your areas

    Give us the neighbourhoods, postal codes or a radius around your store, and the quantity to distribute.

  2. We plan it

    We confirm the price and schedule, and pick up your material from you or your printer.

  3. Distribution confirmed

    Your material is distributed and you receive a report of the areas covered.

FAQ

FAQ — distribution services

What is the minimum quantity?

We take on small neighbourhood campaigns (a few hundred pieces) as well as distributions of tens of thousands of copies.

Can you target specific types of housing?

Yes: single-family homes, apartment buildings, stores or offices, depending on your target customers.

How do I know the distribution was done?

Every campaign ends with a report showing the areas and dates of distribution. Photos can be provided on request.

Do you also print?

No, we focus on distribution. We are happy to pick up the material from your printer.
